Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- MBO/ vocational working and thinking level
- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance
- Full-time employment
- Working in a 5-shift system
- Travel allowance
- Holiday pay

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

A hands-on Network Architect role where Juniper and Fortinet meet complex, business-critical infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational technology organisationoperating critical digital infrastructure. As part of the continued development of their infrastructure environment, they are looking for aNetwork Architectto join a highly skilled and collaborative technical team.

 

This is not a purely conceptual architecture role. You will move betweenarchitecture, design, implementation and production support, working with modern networking technologies and having a direct impact on the resilience and evolution of the infrastructure.

 

Your playground? Juniper, Fortinet, BGP, DNS, security and distributed infrastructure.
Network Architect - The Role
• Design and evolvenetwork architecturesacross complex and distributed production environments, from high-level concepts to low-level technical designs.
• Work hands-on withJuniper networking and Fortinet security technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls and network segmentation.
• Contribute toBGP, DNS/DNSSEC, high-availability and distributed infrastructure, with a strong focus on resilience and security.
• Drive improvements aroundautomation, monitoring and observability, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Prometheus or Grafana.
• Collaborate withInfrastructure, Security, Architecture and Software Engineeringteams, while challenging and validating technical solutions delivered by external partners.
• Maintainarchitecture documentation, diagrams and technical standards, while supporting troubleshooting, lifecycle management and production environments.
Network Architect - The Profile
• 7+ years of experiencein network, infrastructure or systems engineering, with strong exposure to critical production environments.
• Strong expertise innetworking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching and protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
• Solid hands-on experience withJuniper and Fortinet— this is a key part of the role.
• Good understanding ofLinux, DNS/DNSSEC, firewalls and high-availability/distributed infrastructure.
• Exposure tovirtualisation, containers, private cloud or Infrastructure as Code(VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, etc.) is a strong plus.
• Analytical, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move from architecture and design to implementation and production troubleshooting. Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: Full Stack JS Developer | AI Company
jobs.description:
Today, they develop tailor-made, AI-driven software solutions to help companies accelerate their digital transformation.

Our partner, a company specialized in Artificial Intelligence, is looking for a Full JavaScript Software Developer (ReactJS / NodeJS).

Today, they develop tailor-made, AI-driven software solutions to help companies accelerate their digital transformation. Their strong ambition to innovate has driven rapid growth.

With a turnover of several million euros, this scale-up is expanding internationally and currently has offices in Madrid, Paris, Athens, and New York.
Full JS Developer – The Role :
As a Full JS Developer, you will be responsible for developing custom software solutions, building and deploying APIs, and creating web applications.

 

You will play a key role within the team and work closely with the CTO and Project Manager. You will contribute to AI-based projects in a flexible structure, alongside a young and ambitious team that will support your professional growth and career development.

Full JS Developer – Profile :
• You have between 3 and 5 years of experience in software development
• You are a Dutch speaker with a good level of English
• You have strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST APIs, and HTML/CSS

Responsibilities

• Design and develop secure, performant .NET Core Web APIs and software solutions.
• Collaborate with solution designers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical implementations.
• Take full ownership of the end-to-end delivery of complete software solutions.
• Implement and maintain code quality using Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
• Integrate backend APIs and handle offline/online data synchronization for mobile applications.
• Set up and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments.
• Contribute to the team's growth through knowledge sharing and a constructive professional attitude.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in .NET development, including LINQ, async/await, and security practices.
• 3+ years of experience with .NET Core Web API design and development.
• 3+ years of experience in Azure Cloud development, leveraging PaaS and event-driven patterns.
• Proven experience with Unit Testing, Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles across multiple projects.
• Professional experience with SQL and relational database design and optimization.
• Practical knowledge of Git and version control branching strategies.
• You are proactive, show initiative, and can work independently with a strong sense of ownership.
• You're calm and respectful in interactions with strong communication skills.
• You are fluent in English (C1) with C2 level proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps pipelines.
• Knowledge of containerized deployments using Kubernetes and Docker.
• Familiarity with Android application integration and local persistence synchronization.

jobs.occupation: Data Engineer – Azure Databricks & Power BI
jobs.description:

• Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory to support organizational use cases.
• Industrialize models and indicator calculations to ensure they run reliably in production through scheduling, monitoring, and quality checks.
• Build and support Power BI reports including data modeling, DAX measures, and performance optimization.
• Refine and validate existing anomaly detection models using statistical methods and Isolation Forest.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical deliverables within the data lifecycle.
• Document data flows and calculation logic to ensure a smooth handover and maintain technical best practices.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in data science and data engineering roles.
• Strong expertise with Azure Databricks and Azure services including Data Factory, Storage, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
• In-depth experience with Spark, PySpark, and Delta Lake within Lakehouse architectures.
• Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
• Proven track record building Power BI reports including semantic modeling, DAX, and visual design.
• Knowledge of statistics and machine learning, specifically anomaly detection techniques.
• You possess the ability to quickly understand and take over existing code bases and models developed by others.

• You are fluent in English with native or bilingual proficiency in Dutch or French.
